title: Directional Verbal Prefixes: át-, fel-, le-, be-

sections.title: Verbal prefixes expressing physical crossing and movement
sections.content: Hungarian verbal prefixes modify motion verbs: *átkel* (to cross over), *átmegy* (to go across), *beér* (to arrive in/reach), and *felmegy* (to go up). When followed by *keresztül* or *-on / -en / -ön át*, they describe crossing terrain like rivers, passes, and tunnels.

items.spanish: A vonat lassan haladt át a hosszú alagúton.
items.english: The train passed slowly through the long tunnel.

items.spanish: Gyalog keltünk át a folyó feletti hídon.
items.english: We crossed the bridge over the river on foot.

items.spanish: A térkép segítségével könnyen megtaláltuk a hegyi hágót.
items.english: With the help of the map, we easily found the mountain pass.
